proof_boundary: Identical retained literal inputs/assertions and exercised production paths keep original clean observations. Final repairs change diagnostic event correspondence and artifact/SDK inspection only; actual local extraction/judge outputs and contexts remain valid without inference repetition.
review: self review of contracts, code layers, state/data ownership and observed evidence

actual_local.model_verdicts: authored true/false/unknown propositions; finite selected cases
actual_local.hidden_preprocessing: Ollama tokenizer/server internals opaque; actual Tangerine-owned wire/context retained

proof_limits: No all122linguistic or empirical scientific calibration claim
No hosted entitlement or paid-credit qualification
Earlier inherited optional review/acoustic acceptance issues retain their previous status
